 "content": "def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    # Shift the colored object one cell toward the divider; draw an 8 line
    # in the vacated column. The divider remains intact.
    col = next((c for c in range(w) if all(g[r][c] == 2 for r in range(h))), None)
    if col is None:
        return g
    pts = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c] not in (1, 2, 3, 7, 8)]
    if not pts:
        return g
    minc, maxc = min(c for r, c in pts), max(c for r, c in pts)
    delta = -1 if minc > col else 1
    # Clear source object cells, then move one step toward the divider.
    obj = [(r, c, g[r][c]) for r, c in pts]
    for r, c, _ in obj:
        g[r][c] = 1 if all(x in (1, 2) for x in grid[r]) else 3
    for r, c, color in obj:
        g[r][c + delta] = color
    edge = minc if delta < 0 else maxc
    for r in range(h):
        g[r][edge] = 8
    return g
"
}
